description: This Java class, MyGLSurfaceView, is a custom view for rendering OpenGL ES graphics in an Android application. It manages the OpenGL renderer and handles touch events to manipulate the rendered scene.

classes.name: MyGLSurfaceView
classes.description: A custom GLSurfaceView class that sets up an OpenGL renderer and handles touch input for interaction.

methods.name: MyGLSurfaceView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GLSurfaceView, sets the renderer, and configures the render mode.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events to rotate the 3D object based on user input.
